title: Earth's Atmospheric Layers
subject: Geography
description: A diagram illustrating the main layers of Earth's atmosphere, including Troposphere, Stratosphere, Mesosphere, Thermosphere (Ionosphere), and Exosphere, with their approximate altitudes and key characteristics.
